tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and coupled-lag signatures point to the archived five-parameter siphon-memory ODE. The pilot already spans the target horizon of 0.46; the unresolved question is how quickly memory relaxes and how strongly it drives the state. The fine trajectory batch adds time-resolved observations to distinguish those effects before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations at similar horizons provide no redundancy and weakly constrain the memory timescale separately from the coupling strength.
The static law captures the sink gradient but cannot account for the observed coupled transient lag.
The auxiliary measurement does not distinguish memory relaxation from coupling strength.
